description: The Autonomo starter, read only: a one-time gift of a little ETH (gas) and a little $ZENI (the job bond) to a wallet that has paid one Autonomo API call, so it can take its first Tokyo job. Returns the offer, the starters left today and in all, and (if you pass `wallet`) that wallet's state: can_claim, pending, sent, not_eligible or full. Sends nothing.
name: starter_status
